verdict.rationale: Pigment's security docs describe fine-grained data access rights that determine who can see and modify specific data within applications, and the KB lists permissions as a core collaboration feature. That covers the core of letting a budget owner view and edit only their own numbers. missing for 10: explicit documentation of department/dimension-level scoping (e.g. restricting by cost center), detail on separate read vs write rules per department, independent or hands-on corroboration.
